title: How to organise the sorting and hamper zone | Laundry Room
description:
Turn dirty clothes into loads that can go straight into the machine without being handled twice.

This is the Sorting and Hamper Zone in the Laundry Room. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Three labeled bags standing clear of the walking line, each below half full, a small dish on the shelf holding nothing older than today, and bare floor in front of the washer door.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Empty every hamper and see what a real week actually produces: whites, darks, towels, delicates, work clothes.
Straighten: One bag per stream, standing where clothes are actually taken off rather than where the bags happen to fit.
Shine: Damp gym kit is what makes a hamper smell, not dirt.
Safety: A hamper parked on a landing or at the top of a step is a fall you take with your arms full and your view bloc
Standardize: Label each bag with the load it makes rather than the colour it holds: hot towels, cold darks, gentle.
Sustain: Pockets get checked as the item goes into the bag, not later at the machine.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Every bag is a load, labeled by wash setting, and emptied before it passes half full.
